description: This file provides benchmarking utilities for measuring throughput and latency of PyTorch modules, including classes for formatting time, recording execution stats, and a wrapper class for performing throughput benchmarking with detailed configuration options.

classes.name: ExecutionStats
classes.description: Class for calculating and representing benchmarking execution statistics such as average latency, total iterations, and total time.

classes.name: ThroughputBenchmark
classes.description: Wrapper class around a C++ throughput benchmarking component, enabling performance measurement of PyTorch modules.
